prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a low-speed head-on collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1084; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the motor vehicle collision referenced in your file. Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, either by telephone, mail, or in person. Our client sustained injuries in a low-speed head-on collision and is currently receiving medical treatment, and we expect the full nature and extent of those injuries to be documented as care continues.

We request that you provide a complete copy of the liability and bodily injury policy covering the at-fault driver, including a written statement of all applicable policy limits, and confirm in writing whether any additional coverage, such as an umbrella or excess policy, may apply. Please also confirm the claim number assigned to this loss.

We further ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, vehicle damage appraisals, telematics or event data recorder information, recorded statements, adjuster notes, and any communications with the insured or third parties. Please treat this letter as formal notice of the duty to preserve these materials.
